prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, take it and check its properties. If object is visible, move and process it. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectWeight    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = TakeObject    />     <Action ID = CheckObjectColor    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = MoveTowardsObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectWeight
	END
